Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not put my full name on it yet, my attorney said to keep things brief until we've reviewed everything.
Q: That's understandable. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Katy, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the main entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I had just checked my mirror and started reversing slowly. I was going maybe five miles an hour.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before it hit you?
A: Not really. I heard a horn and then felt the impact on the driver's side rear of my car.
Q: Which direction was the other vehicle traveling?
A: It was coming down the main aisle, I think heading toward the exit. It didn't look like it slowed down.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I put my right hand out to brace myself against the steering wheel and I landed on it wrong. The doctor says
my wrist is fractured and I'm in a cast.
Q: Did you receive medical treatment at the scene or afterward?
A: An ambulance took me to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. I've had two follow-up visits since then.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?
A: Only that there were several people nearby, and I think a couple of them saw what happened. I didn't get their
contact information, unfortunately.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with you in writing about next steps.
A: Okay, thanks.
</page>
